content:
Lean4lean (@Mario Carneiro) was an inspiration for me to write metalean. However I think metalean is still far from usable yet, and that is why I wanted to ask about the future of Lean4lean.

  • Metalean idealises a lot of the type theory
  • ... whereas L4L is cautious to get it right from the start
  • It's missing nested inductives, and the fact that it is committed to not implementing them, makes the type theory awkward to implement that of @Arthur Adjedj
  • ... whereas L4L is committed to implementing them
  • It's slow because the checker was not the primary goal, rather, the metatheory only
  • ... whereas L4L was based on the official kernel from the start
    Thoughts?
